subject: the Oracle bulk offload

source.read_speed_note: 4 parallel streams; 8 streams gave 5.3 MB/s — no further gain

route.shape: direct pod -> Oracle pull, over SSH agent forwarding
route.mac_role: key broker only; the Mac is not in the data path
route.verification: --partial --append-verify verifies against the source and reconciles with the 453,102 files already on the pod from the run paused on 16 October
route.estimated_duration: about 2 hours 25 minutes at ~5 MB/s aggregate, bound by Oracle's egress
route.why_not_through_the_mac: it needs a local 29-44 GB staging copy on a volume with about 1.7 GB free

destinations_measured.note: df reports 436 TB free and the write still fails: the free space is not this user's
the bulk is 43.7 GB and the overlay has 9.6 GB free

decision.reason: neither candidate destination on the pod can take the bulk: the shared mount is quota-blocked and the overlay has 9.6 GB free against 43.7 GB
decision.owner_gate: a third destination — a different pod, a larger volume, or an object store — is an owner decision

contradicted_claims.claim: the 7.6 GB pod quota is gone
contradicted_claims.was_in: the first version of this receipt
contradicted_claims.why: it is a per-user quota on a shared filesystem and it is still in force; the 40 GB write that seemed to disprove it landed on the overlay volume, not on the shared mount
contradicted_claims.evidence: /workspace/csoai already holds 26 GB, so the quota is spent rather than absent

claims_that_stand.claim: the estate's ssh config marks oracle-micro (145.241.232.16) as DEAD
claims_that_stand.detail: the host is alive and reachable; it is micro2 — the host the plan calls Oracle — whose guest wedged and then recovered. The config's dead-host entry names the wrong machine.

claims_that_stand.claim: m2 and oracle-micro are not the source
claims_that_stand.detail: m2 holds 2,061,092 files; oracle-micro carries an August-era generation of 267K files; the source is 1,226,000 files

side_effects.pod_probe_files_note: both probe files were removed after the 2026-10-29T09:41:00Z measurement

not_a_certification: This is a file-movement receipt: what the source measured, where the bytes were going to go, how fast, what was not done, and — where a first measurement turned out to be wrong — what the correction is.
